final_refit.policy: Independent fixed-seed proportional month x outcome sample from all eligible 2025 flights, shared across A/B and all classifiers; use only after validation choices are frozen.

preprocessing.indicator_policy: Median impute every numeric predictor; skip redundant automatic indicators for columns represented by explicit missingness flags. Preserve automatic indicators for remaining numeric predictors, including wind and gust.
preprocessing.month_encoding: Fixed 12-month sine/cosine; raw month retained for audit, sampling and Tableau.

feature_engineering.test_outcome_policy: No 2026 outcome EDA or feature/model/threshold selection; labels and final scoring use frozen rules.

weather.cloud_extraction: All METAR body layers before RMK, with structured sky-column fallback; unknown ceiling heights remain missing

history.event_definition: scheduled departure UTC + reported departure delay
history.evaluation_policy: Frozen rolling rule; earlier 2026 outcomes may enter later test histories only after the seven-day lag. No classifier is refitted on 2026.

feature_engineering.traffic: All scheduled origin departures in [query scheduled departure-60m, query scheduled departure)
feature_engineering.study_design: Historical simulation with unverified weather/outcome receipt and schedule-availability assumptions
